name_zh: 越南·陈兴道：抗蒙军事与游击水战天才
name_en: Vietnam Tran Hung Dao: Anti-Mongol Military & Guerrilla Naval Genius
description_zh: 陈兴道 (1228-1300) 陈朝大将，三次抗元战争白藤江决战以桩阵水战歼灭蒙古舰队，著《兵书要诀》奠定越南军事思想传统。
description_en: Tran Hung Dao (1228-1300) Tran Dynasty general, three anti-Yuan wars Bach Dang River decisive battle used stake trap naval warfare annihilated Mongol fleet, authored Book of Military Principles founding Vietnamese military thought tradition.
reason_zh: 陈兴道代表农业文明通过水战非对称优势击败游牧帝国军事机器的奇迹，展示了地理环境如何转化为军事战略决定性优势，其兵法思想影响越南千年抗外传统。
reason_en: Tran Hung Dao represents agricultural civilization defeating nomadic empire military machine through naval asymmetric advantage miracle, demonstrating how geography transforms into decisive military strategic advantage, his military thought influencing Vietnamese millennium anti-foreign tradition.
steps_zh: 研究陈兴道早年儒将教育与陈朝军事改革
分析1258/1285/1288三次抗元战争战术演进
探讨1288白藤江桩阵水战战术创新与心理战
评估《兵书要诀》游击战思想与越南军事传统
总结抗蒙军事天才对越南民族认同的奠基作用
steps_en: Study Tran Hung Dao early Confucian general education and Tran Dynasty military reform
Analyze 1258/1285/1288 three anti-Yuan wars tactical evolution
Explore 1288 Bach Dang stake trap naval warfare tactical innovation and psychological warfare
Evaluate Book of Military Principles guerrilla thought and Vietnamese military tradition
Summarize anti-Mongol military genius foundational role for Vietnamese national identity
expected_zh: 掌握水战非对称战术与游击战思想双重创新，理解地理决定论在军事史上的极致体现，评估陈兴道对越南千年抗外传统的决定性奠基。
expected_en: Master naval asymmetric tactics and guerrilla thought dual innovation, understand geographical determinism ultimate embodiment in military history, evaluate Tran Hung Dao decisive foundation for Vietnamese millennium anti-foreign tradition.
case_zh: 1228 出生；1258 首战；1288 白藤江大捷；1300 逝世。抗蒙军事游击水战范式永存。
case_en: 1228 birth; 1258 first battle; 1288 Bach Dang victory; 1300 death. Anti-Mongol military guerrilla naval paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Naval warfare innovation; stake trap; anti-Mongol victory; military tradition
